subject: Proposal: Premium SLO onboarding + cost-share for renewal
messages:
From: Olly Jensen <olly.jensen@brightpark.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: nina.rao@brightpark.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Looking ahead to renewal — premium SLO questions

Hi Laura,

Renewal for BrightPark's account is coming up in August and execs are asking whether we can move to a premium SLO with an explicit 99.9% p99 latency commitment for our critical inference routes. We like Redwood's reliability, but before we escalate procurement I need: a short summary of what the premium SLO includes, an estimate of incremental monthly cost, and a proposed onboarding timeline that won't disrupt our Q3 launch.

Also — our infra team asked if Redwood will help with the initial SLO tuning (burst policies, cache priming) and whether BrightPark can request a one-time onboarding credit given the size of our commit.

Thanks,
Olly
SRE Lead, BrightPark
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olly Jensen <olly.jensen@brightpark.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Looking ahead to renewal — premium SLO questions

Hi Olly — thanks for the clear list. Internal cc to loop in Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Solutions) so we can put numbers and a playbook together.

Quick answers up front:
- Premium SLO: 99.9% p99 latency objective for configured production routes, prioritized capacity on Dedicated pool (or reserved burst on Hosted), 24/7 priority support, and quarterly SLA review.
- Onboarding: we offer a 2–4 week technical onboarding for SLO tuning (workshops + live tuning), and can run a one-week targeted cache-priming exercise right before your Q3 traffic spike.
- Cost: rough delta depends on commit size; I'll have Ben put a worked example in the next message.

I believe a partial cost-share (one-time) for onboarding is reasonable given your expansion. Marissa — suggestions on how we structure the credit & commercial language?

Best,
Laura
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Draft pricing + ops plan for BrightPark premium SLO

Attaching a quick model and a mutual action plan (bp_mutual_action_plan.xlsx) — key points below.

- Baseline: BrightPark current spend is ~$42k/mo (hosted tokens + embeddings).
- Premium SLO delta: +20–30% on hosted per-token unit (or fixed uplift if they move to Dedicated). For a Dedicated reserve with predictable throughput, estimate +$8k–$12k/mo depending on burst profile.
- One-time onboarding credit: recommend $10k credit applied over first two billing cycles contingent on a 12-month commit. This covers 3 dedicated engineering days for tuning and a cache-priming run.
- Timeline: Proposal signed by July 20 -> SLO onboarding week of Aug 3 -> Full SLO enforcement and reporting by Aug 17 (before Q3 launch).

I also included an ops playbook: traffic routing config, cache warmup checklist, fallback model variants, runbook for latency incidents, and an agreed communications cadence (weekly for first month).

Let me know if you want me to convert the workbook into the DocuSign template.

—Ben
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_premium-slo-draft.pdf]
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olly Jensen <olly.jensen@brightpark.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightpark.com
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial note + proposed contract language for onboarding credit

Hi Olly — happy to own the commercial side. Proposed terms:
1) 12-month commitment at agreed baseline consumption band.
2) One-time onboarding credit of $10,000 applied as a billing credit split over first two invoices.
3) Premium SLO addendum: 99.9% p99 latency on routes listed in Appendix A; 30-day rollback window if BrightPark wants to revert to standard SLO.
4) Failure to meet SLO triggers remediation credits (per SLA table) not to exceed 10% of monthly invoice.

We will add a clause that Redwood will provide up to three engineering days (remote) for tuning during onboarding; any additional days will be billed at our standard rate.

If this looks good I can prepare the addendum and send via DocuSign next week. Olivia (procurement) — will the credit structure work on your side?

Best,
Marissa
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Olly Jensen <olly.jensen@brightpark.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: nina.rao@brightpark.com, procurement@brightpark.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial note + proposed contract language for onboarding credit

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Procurement confirms the onboarding credit structure works, and legal has a couple of small redlines around the rollback window (asking for 45 days instead of 30) and a slightly higher cap on remediation credits. I'll loop legal and procurement into a short call.

Next steps per our side:
- BrightPark to confirm final routes for SLO Appendix A by July 14.
- Procurement to accept DocuSign addendum once legal redlines are reconciled.
- Target: countersigned by July 20 so Redwood can start the Aug 3 onboarding.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Olly
SRE Lead, BrightPark
